gif.title: A web request in layers
gif.subtitle: Pull the request apart into five layers

layers.title: Browser layer
layers.sub: Builds the address, sends headers, waits for the answer

layers.title: Network layer
layers.sub: DNS finds the server and TLS keeps traffic private

layers.title: Edge layer
layers.sub: A CDN serves cached files; a load balancer spreads traffic

layers.title: Application layer
layers.sub: Checks the user, applies business rules, builds the response

layers.title: Data layer
layers.sub: A database stores records; a cache keeps hot answers close
